description: Implement bounded HTTP adapters and scheduled ingestion for indexed sources only after a registry entry documents an explicit compatible licence or service agreement, admitting aggregate status fields but never copying narratives or identity claims.
acceptance: Every indexed source with explicit compatible ingestion and republication rights can be fetched through a rate-limited adapter that honors terms, stores only permitted aggregate status fields, and preserves source record, retrieval time, transformation, and content digest.

Sources without documented rights, credentials, privacy approval, takedown ownership, or supported values remain disabled and perform zero report-page requests; robots permission alone cannot enable ingestion.
Free text, names, lookup popularity, requester data, and source-native safe claims cannot enter reputation processing; source outage and drift fail closed without converting absence into safety.

review_history.evidence: Approved after direct acceptance readback: only cross-approved licensed services with runtime credentials can instantiate an adapter; current public configuration creates zero adapters and zero requests; the tested feed projection admits only neutral aggregate status metadata with provenance/freshness and cannot turn missing, stale, unknown, unsafe-native, or failed source data into safety.
